votes.motion: Approve the ANR Plan for 176 Elmwood Road (two-lot division).
votes.quote: p. bertram made motion to approve the anr plan for 176 elm wood road, t. cole seconded, roll call vote: t. cole, aye; m. thompson, aye; p. bertram, aye; m. allison, aye. vote passed 4-0.

votes.motion: Approve the Stormwater Permit for 1325 Massachusetts Avenue, with the condition that sediment forebay maintenance be incorporated into the Stormwater Operation and Maintenance Manual and the installed monitoring well be removed.
votes.quote: t. cole made motion to approve the stormwater permit for 1325 massachusetts avenue, p. bertram seconded for discussion

votes.motion: Approve the Site Plan for 1325 Massachusetts Avenue as proposed, with a seeded four to six foot high earthen berm from the eastern property line along the northern property line in lieu of the plantings.
votes.quote: p. bertram made motion to approve the site plan as proposed with the condition that a four (4) to six (6) foot high earthen berm
03.09.2020- p. bertram made motion to approve, t. cole seconded, roll call vote: m. thompson, aye; t. cole, aye; p. bertram, aye; m. allison, aye. vote passed 4-0.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of 03.09.2020, 1325 Massachusetts Avenue.
votes.quote: 03.09.2020, 1325 massachusetts avenue - p. bertram made motion to approve, t. cole seconded
